---- MODULE W4Od14m1p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES holder, epoch, grantEpoch, surveyed, authHolder

ASSUME Drones = 0 .. 2

Nxt(d) == (d + 1) % 3

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Drones
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
  /\ grantEpoch \in [Drones -> -1 .. MaxEpoch]
  /\ surveyed \subseteq [drone: Drones, epoch: 0 .. MaxEpoch]
  /\ authHolder \in [0 .. MaxEpoch -> Drones]

Init ==
  /\ holder = 0
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ grantEpoch = [d \in Drones |-> IF d = 0 THEN 0 ELSE -1]
  /\ surveyed = {}
  /\ authHolder = [e \in 0 .. MaxEpoch |-> 0]

Survey(d) ==
  /\ holder = d
  /\ grantEpoch[d] = epoch
  /\ surveyed' = surveyed \cup {[drone |-> d, epoch |-> epoch]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, grantEpoch, authHolder>>

PassToken ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ LET nx == Nxt(holder) IN
       /\ holder' = nx
       /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
       /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![nx] = epoch + 1]
       /\ authHolder' = [authHolder EXCEPT ![epoch + 1] = nx]
  /\ UNCHANGED surveyed

RefreshGrant(d) ==
  /\ holder = d
  /\ grantEpoch[d] < epoch
  /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![d] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, surveyed, authHolder>>

MarkStale(d) ==
  /\ grantEpoch[d] >= 0
  /\ grantEpoch[d] < epoch
  /\ holder # d
  /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![d] = -1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, surveyed, authHolder>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Survey(d)
  \/ PassToken
  \/ \E d \in Drones : RefreshGrant(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : MarkStale(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, epoch, grantEpoch, surveyed, authHolder>>

OnlyAuthorizedSurveys ==
  \A r \in surveyed : authHolder[r.epoch] = r.drone
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Drones = {0,1,2} MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedSurveys
nl:
A swarm of surveillance drones patrols a wildfire perimeter arranged in a logical ring. Exactly one drone at a time holds a circulating survey token, and only the token holder is authorized to record a survey of its sector. The token is passed hand-to-hand around the ring; each pass advances a monotonic epoch counter so that every grant of the token carries a fresh generation number. Each drone keeps a local note of which epoch its current grant belongs to, and a drone that has fallen behind (slow, but not failed) may still be carrying a stale grant from an earlier epoch. A drone is permitted to survey only when it is the current holder AND its local grant epoch matches the live epoch, which excludes both non-holders and holders acting on a stale grant. A slow drone can catch its grant up to the live epoch, or have a lingering stale grant explicitly marked. Every survey that is actually recorded is stamped with the epoch at which it happened.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every recorded survey was performed by the drone that was the authorized token holder at the epoch stamped on that survey, so no unauthorized or stale drone ever appears in the survey log.

---- MODULE W4Od11m1p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Stations, Jobs
VARIABLES holder, total, committed, active

Pages(j) == 2 * j

SumPages(S) ==
  LET f[T \in SUBSET Jobs] ==
        IF T = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE IN Pages(x) + f[T \ {x}]
  IN f[S]

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Stations
  /\ total \in Nat
  /\ committed \subseteq Jobs
  /\ active \subseteq Stations

Init ==
  /\ holder \in Stations
  /\ total = 0
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ active = Stations

CommitJob(s, j) ==
  /\ holder = s
  /\ s \in active
  /\ j \notin committed
  /\ total' = total + Pages(j)
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active>>

PassToken(s) ==
  /\ holder # s
  /\ s \in active
  /\ holder \in active
  /\ holder' = s
  /\ UNCHANGED <<total, committed, active>>

BringOnline(s) ==
  /\ s \notin active
  /\ active' = active \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, total, committed>>

TakeOffline(s) ==
  /\ s \in active
  /\ s # holder
  /\ active' = active \ {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, total, committed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations, j \in Jobs : CommitJob(s, j)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : PassToken(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : BringOnline(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : TakeOffline(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, total, committed, active>>

NoLostUpdate == total = SumPages(committed)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Stations = {s1,s2,s3} Jobs = {1,2,3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A print shop runs several spooler stations arranged in a ring that share a single accounting record: the running total of pages billed. To prevent two stations from reading the total, adding their job, and writing back over each other (a lost update), a single circulating token grants exclusive write access; only the station currently holding the token may fold a print job's page count into the shared total. Jobs have different page sizes. The token is passed around the ring from one active station to another. The shop can reconfigure at runtime: stations can be brought online or taken offline, so the set of active stations that participate in the ring grows and shrinks, but the token is always held by an active station. Each job is billed at most once, and its pages are added exactly once. The shared total must always equal the exact sum of the page counts of the jobs that have been committed so far.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared page total always equals the exact sum of the page counts of all committed jobs, so no station's update is ever lost or double-counted.

---- MODULE W4Od15m4p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences
CONSTANTS Traders, MaxNonce, MaxCap
VARIABLES queue, cap, issued, draining

Range(seq) == { seq[i] : i \in DOMAIN seq }

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq([trader: Traders, nonce: 0 .. MaxNonce])
  /\ cap \in 1 .. MaxCap
  /\ issued \in [Traders -> 0 .. MaxNonce]
  /\ draining \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ cap = 1
  /\ issued = [t \in Traders |-> 0]
  /\ draining = FALSE

Submit(t) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, [trader |-> t, nonce |-> issued[t]])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, issued, draining>>

Rotate(t) ==
  /\ issued[t] < MaxNonce
  /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![t] = issued[t] + 1]
  /\ queue' = SelectSeq(queue, LAMBDA o : o.trader # t)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, draining>>

ChangeCapacity ==
  /\ \E c \in 1 .. MaxCap : cap' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, issued, draining>>

Process ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ draining' = ~draining
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, issued>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Traders : Submit(t)
  \/ \E t \in Traders : Rotate(t)
  \/ ChangeCapacity
  \/ Process

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<queue, cap, issued, draining>>

NoStaleOrderQueued == \A o \in Range(queue) : o.nonce = issued[o.trader]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Traders = {t1,t2} MaxNonce = 2 MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleOrderQueued
nl:
Before a stock exchange opens, an opening-auction gateway accepts order submissions from traders into a bounded intake queue. Each trader holds a session nonce issued by the exchange; a submission is accepted only if it presents the trader's current nonce, and the queue applies backpressure by refusing new orders once it is full. When the exchange rotates a trader's session (for example after a credential refresh), it increments that trader's issued nonce, which makes any nonce the trader was previously using stale; to keep the book clean, the rotation also purges any of that trader's orders still sitting in the queue. The intake capacity can change at runtime as the venue widens or narrows the auction. The matching engine drains orders from the front of the queue as it processes them. Because acceptance is gated on the live nonce and rotation purges stale entries, the queue can never hold an order stamped with anything other than the trader's currently issued nonce.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every order resident in the intake queue carries exactly the nonce currently issued to its submitting trader, so no stale or unauthorized submission is ever queued.

---- MODULE W4Od5m9p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Slots, Players, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES allocA, allocB, epoch, assigned

Leader(e) == IF e % 2 = 0 THEN "A" ELSE "B"

TypeOK ==
  /\ allocA \subseteq Slots
  /\ allocB \subseteq Slots
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
  /\ assigned \in [Slots -> Players \cup {"free"}]

Init ==
  /\ allocA = {}
  /\ allocB = {}
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ assigned = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]

ClaimA(s, p) ==
  /\ Leader(epoch) = "A"
  /\ s \notin allocA /\ s \notin allocB
  /\ allocA' = allocA \cup {s}
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = p]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocB, epoch>>

ClaimB(s, p) ==
  /\ Leader(epoch) = "B"
  /\ s \notin allocA /\ s \notin allocB
  /\ allocB' = allocB \cup {s}
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = p]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocA, epoch>>

ReleaseA(s) ==
  /\ s \in allocA
  /\ allocA' = allocA \ {s}
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocB, epoch>>

ReleaseB(s) ==
  /\ s \in allocB
  /\ allocB' = allocB \ {s}
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocA, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocA, allocB, assigned>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, p \in Players : ClaimA(s, p)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, p \in Players : ClaimB(s, p)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : ReleaseA(s)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : ReleaseB(s)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<allocA, allocB, epoch, assigned>>

DisjointOwnership == allocA \cap allocB = {}
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Slots = {x1,x2} Players = {pa,pb} MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DisjointOwnership
nl:
Two independent matchmaker instances, A and B, draw from one shared pool of game-lobby slots. To stop them from ever handing the same slot to two different players, the system uses epoch-numbered reconfiguration: a monotonic epoch counter decides which single instance is the active allocator, with even epochs led by instance A and odd epochs by instance B. Only the current epoch's leader may claim a free slot for a player, and it may claim a slot only when that slot is held by neither instance. Either instance may release a slot it owns back to the pool. A reconfiguration advances the epoch and thereby flips leadership to the other instance. Because exactly one instance leads at any time and a claim is permitted only on a wholly free slot, the two instances' sets of owned slots stay disjoint. No slot is ever simultaneously owned by both matchmakers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of slots owned by instance A and the set owned by instance B are always disjoint, so the same slot is never double-allocated across the two instances.

---- MODULE W4Od11m2p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS RMs, MaxRound
VARIABLES coord, votes, applied, curAmount, round

TypeOK ==
  /\ coord \in {"idle","preparing","committed","aborted"}
  /\ votes \in [RMs -> {"none","yes","crashed"}]
  /\ applied \in Nat
  /\ curAmount \in 0 .. 2
  /\ round \in 0 .. MaxRound

Init ==
  /\ coord = "idle"
  /\ votes = [r \in RMs |-> "none"]
  /\ applied = 0
  /\ curAmount = 0
  /\ round = 0

StartTxn ==
  /\ coord = "idle"
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ \E a \in 1 .. 2 : curAmount' = a
  /\ coord' = "preparing"
  /\ votes' = [r \in RMs |-> "none"]
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED applied

Vote(r) ==
  /\ coord = "preparing"
  /\ votes[r] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, applied, curAmount, round>>

Crash(r) ==
  /\ coord = "preparing"
  /\ votes[r] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = "crashed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, applied, curAmount, round>>

Commit ==
  /\ coord = "preparing"
  /\ \A r \in RMs : votes[r] = "yes"
  /\ coord' = "committed"
  /\ applied' = applied + curAmount
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, curAmount, round>>

Abort ==
  /\ coord = "preparing"
  /\ \E r \in RMs : votes[r] = "crashed"
  /\ coord' = "aborted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, applied, curAmount, round>>

Reset ==
  /\ coord \in {"committed","aborted"}
  /\ coord' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, applied, curAmount, round>>

Finish ==
  /\ coord = "idle"
  /\ round = MaxRound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, votes, applied, curAmount, round>>

Next ==
  \/ StartTxn
  \/ \E r \in RMs : Vote(r)
  \/ \E r \in RMs : Crash(r)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Reset
  \/ Finish

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<coord, votes, applied, curAmount, round>>

CommitIsUnanimous == (coord = "committed") => (\A r \in RMs : votes[r] = "yes")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS RMs = {r1,r2} MaxRound = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommitIsUnanimous
nl:
A print shop commits each billing update to a shared ledger through a two-phase commit across several resource managers, each of which must durably apply the same page-count delta. A coordinator opens a transaction proposing a page amount, then each resource manager either votes yes (it has prepared and will apply the delta) or crashes silently and stops responding. The coordinator commits only when every resource manager has voted yes; if any manager has crashed, the coordinator aborts and the shared ledger is left untouched. Because a commit requires a unanimous set of yes votes, a silently crashed manager can never be masked by a commit, so the coordinator never records an update that some manager failed to apply. After a transaction commits or aborts, the coordinator resets to start another round, up to a fixed number of rounds. The shared running total is only ever advanced by a fully committed, unanimously prepared transaction.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the coordinator is in the committed state, every resource manager has voted yes, so no update is ever committed while a participant has silently crashed.

---- MODULE W4Od7m2p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cranes, Containers
VARIABLES pending, votes, placed, history

Range(seq) == { seq[i] : i \in DOMAIN seq }

TypeOK ==
  /\ pending \in Containers \cup {"none"}
  /\ votes \in [Cranes -> {"none","yes"}]
  /\ placed \subseteq Containers
  /\ history \in Seq(Containers)

Init ==
  /\ pending = "none"
  /\ votes = [c \in Cranes |-> "none"]
  /\ placed = {}
  /\ history = << >>

BeginLift(k) ==
  /\ pending = "none"
  /\ k \notin placed
  /\ pending' = k
  /\ votes' = [c \in Cranes |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<placed, history>>

Vote(c) ==
  /\ pending # "none"
  /\ votes[c] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, placed, history>>

Commit ==
  /\ pending # "none"
  /\ \A c \in Cranes : votes[c] = "yes"
  /\ placed' = placed \cup {pending}
  /\ history' = Append(history, pending)
  /\ pending' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

AdminOverride(k) ==
  /\ pending = "none"
  /\ k \notin placed
  /\ placed' = placed \cup {k}
  /\ history' = Append(history, k)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes>>

Abort ==
  /\ pending # "none"
  /\ pending' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, placed, history>>

YardIdle ==
  /\ pending = "none"
  /\ placed = Containers
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes, placed, history>>

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in Containers : BeginLift(k)
  \/ \E c \in Cranes : Vote(c)
  \/ Commit
  \/ \E k \in Containers : AdminOverride(k)
  \/ Abort
  \/ YardIdle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<pending, votes, placed, history>>

PlacedAtMostOnce == \A i, j \in DOMAIN history : history[i] = history[j] => i = j
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Cranes = {c1,c2} Containers = {b1,b2,b3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PlacedAtMostOnce
nl:
In a container-ship crane yard, permanently placing a container into a stow slot is an irreversible action, so it is committed through a two-phase commit among the participating cranes. A lift begins for a container that has not yet been placed; each crane then votes yes that it is prepared. When all cranes have voted yes, the placement commits: the container is recorded as placed and appended to the placement history. A privileged yard admin may override the normal protocol and force a placement directly, but even the override refuses to place a container that has already been placed. A lift in progress may also be aborted, returning to idle without placing anything. Because both the normal commit path and the admin override guard on the container not already being placed, every container is placed at most once and the placement history never contains a duplicate.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the placement history never lists the same container twice, so the irreversible placement of any given container happens at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od19m5p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Replicas, Books, MaxTerm, Quorum
VARIABLES term, reqBook, reqTerm, voters, committed

CommittedBooks == { c.book : c \in committed }

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm
  /\ reqBook \in Books \cup {"none"}
  /\ reqTerm \in 0 .. MaxTerm
  /\ voters \subseteq Replicas
  /\ committed \subseteq [book: Books, term: 0 .. MaxTerm, voters: SUBSET Replicas]

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ reqBook = "none"
  /\ reqTerm = 0
  /\ voters = {}
  /\ committed = {}

StartRequest(b) ==
  /\ reqBook = "none"
  /\ b \notin CommittedBooks
  /\ reqBook' = b
  /\ reqTerm' = term
  /\ voters' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, committed>>

Vote(r) ==
  /\ reqBook # "none"
  /\ reqTerm = term
  /\ r \notin voters
  /\ voters' = voters \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqBook, reqTerm, committed>>

CommitReq ==
  /\ reqBook # "none"
  /\ Cardinality(voters) >= Quorum
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {[book |-> reqBook, term |-> reqTerm, voters |-> voters]}
  /\ reqBook' = "none"
  /\ voters' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqTerm>>

NewTerm ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ reqBook' = "none"
  /\ voters' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqTerm, committed>>

CancelReq ==
  /\ reqBook # "none"
  /\ reqBook' = "none"
  /\ voters' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqTerm, committed>>

Idle ==
  /\ reqBook = "none"
  /\ term = MaxTerm
  /\ CommittedBooks = Books
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqBook, reqTerm, voters, committed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Books : StartRequest(b)
  \/ \E r \in Replicas : Vote(r)
  \/ CommitReq
  \/ NewTerm
  \/ CancelReq
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<term, reqBook, reqTerm, voters, committed>>

QuorumCertified == \A c \in committed : Cardinality(c.voters) >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Replicas = {n1,n2,n3} Books = {b1,b2} MaxTerm = 2 Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumCertified
nl:
A library book-reservation service is replicated across several nodes, and every reservation must be ratified by a quorum of replicas before it takes effect. A request to reserve a book is opened in the current configuration term; replicas then cast votes for that pending request, but a replica votes only when the request's term matches the live term. Some replicas may be slow and lag in voting, yet as long as a quorum eventually votes, the reservation can still be certified. If the configuration advances to a new term, any half-collected votes for the old request are discarded, so a stale request left over from an earlier term can never accumulate a quorum. A reservation is committed only when the number of collected votes reaches the quorum threshold, and each committed reservation permanently records the set of replicas that ratified it. No reservation can be enacted by fewer than a quorum of replicas.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every committed reservation was ratified by at least a quorum of replicas, so no reservation is ever enacted by an unauthorized sub-quorum or a stale request.

---- MODULE W4Od1m1p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences
CONSTANTS Stations, Updates
VARIABLES holder, log, acked, active

LogSet == { log[i] : i \in DOMAIN log }

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Stations
  /\ log \in Seq(Updates)
  /\ acked \subseteq Updates
  /\ active \subseteq Stations

Init ==
  /\ holder \in Stations
  /\ log = << >>
  /\ acked = {}
  /\ active = Stations

ApplyUpdate(s, u) ==
  /\ holder = s
  /\ s \in active
  /\ u \notin acked
  /\ log' = Append(log, u)
  /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active>>

PassToken(s) ==
  /\ holder # s
  /\ s \in active
  /\ holder \in active
  /\ holder' = s
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, active>>

BringOnline(s) ==
  /\ s \notin active
  /\ active' = active \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, log, acked>>

TakeOffline(s) ==
  /\ s \in active
  /\ s # holder
  /\ active' = active \ {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, log, acked>>

Idle ==
  /\ acked = Updates
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, log, acked, active>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations, u \in Updates : ApplyUpdate(s, u)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : PassToken(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : BringOnline(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : TakeOffline(s)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, log, acked, active>>

AckedMatchesLog == acked = LogSet
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Stations = {a1,a2,a3} Updates = {u1,u2,u3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AckedMatchesLog
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator maintains a shared append-only log of runway-assignment updates. Several controller stations sit in a ring and share write access to this log, coordinated by a single circulating token: only the station holding the token may apply an update, ensuring updates are serialized and none is lost by concurrent overwrites. When the token holder applies an update it both appends the update's identifier to the shared log and marks that update acknowledged, in one atomic step. The token is passed around the ring between active stations, and the ring can be reconfigured at runtime as controller stations are brought online or taken offline. Because every acknowledgement is produced together with its log entry, the set of acknowledged updates always coincides exactly with the set of updates recorded in the log.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of acknowledged updates always equals the set of updates present in the shared log, so no acknowledged update is ever lost from the record.

---- MODULE W4Od8m0p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Seats, Students, MaxVer
VARIABLES occ, ver, readVer

TypeOK ==
  /\ occ \in [Seats -> SUBSET Students]
  /\ ver \in [Seats -> 0 .. MaxVer]
  /\ readVer \in [Students -> [Seats -> 0 .. MaxVer]]

Init ==
  /\ occ = [s \in Seats |-> {}]
  /\ ver = [s \in Seats |-> 0]
  /\ readVer = [st \in Students |-> [s \in Seats |-> 0]]

OptimisticRead(st, s) ==
  /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![st][s] = ver[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver>>

Enter(st, s) ==
  /\ occ[s] = {}
  /\ readVer[st][s] = ver[s]
  /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![s] = occ[s] \cup {st}]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = ver[s] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED readVer

Release(st, s) ==
  /\ st \in occ[s]
  /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![s] = occ[s] \ {st}]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = ver[s] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED readVer

Idle ==
  /\ \A s \in Seats : ver[s] = MaxVer
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, readVer>>

Next ==
  \/ \E st \in Students, s \in Seats : OptimisticRead(st, s)
  \/ \E st \in Students, s \in Seats : Enter(st, s)
  \/ \E st \in Students, s \in Seats : Release(st, s)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<occ, ver, readVer>>

SeatMutualExclusion ==
  \A s \in Seats : occ[s] = {} \/ (\E st \in Students : occ[s] = {st})
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Seats = {c1,c2} Students = {s1,s2} MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SeatMutualExclusion
nl:
A university course-registration system guards each course seat as a critical resource that at most one student may occupy at a time, using optimistic locking with retry. Each seat carries a version number. A student first performs an optimistic read, recording the seat's current version; later, the student attempts to commit and take the seat only if the seat is currently unoccupied and the version it read still matches the seat's live version. A successful entry bumps the seat's version, which invalidates any other student's earlier read so those attempts must retry. Requests can arrive and be processed in any order, so reads and commits from different students interleave arbitrarily. A student holding a seat may release it, again bumping the version. Because entry requires the seat to be unoccupied, the set of students occupying any given seat is never larger than one.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every seat, the set of students currently occupying it is either empty or a single student, so the seat is never held by two students at once.

---- MODULE W4Od12m4p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences
CONSTANTS Tasks, MaxCap
VARIABLES queue, applied, admitted, cap, lastWorker

QueueSet == { queue[i] : i \in DOMAIN queue }

  /\ queue \in Seq(Tasks)
  /\ applied \subseteq Tasks
  /\ admitted \subseteq Tasks
  /\ cap \in 1 .. MaxCap
  /\ lastWorker \in {"none","A","B"}

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ admitted = {}
  /\ cap = 1
  /\ lastWorker = "none"

Admit(t) ==
  /\ t \notin admitted
  /\ Len(queue) < cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
  /\ admitted' = admitted \cup {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, cap, lastWorker>>

  /\ applied' = applied \cup {Head(queue)}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ lastWorker' = w
  /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, cap>>

  \/ ApplyBy("B")
  \/ ChangeCapacity

A blood-bank inventory tracker records stock adjustments as tasks placed on a single bounded work queue. New adjustment tasks are admitted only while the queue has room; once it is full the system applies backpressure and refuses further admissions. Two independent worker instances, A and B, both draw from this one shared queue: each worker takes the task at the front of the queue and applies it, and taking a task removes it from the queue in the same step so the two workers never both apply the same task. Every task is admitted at most once. At all times the tasks that have been admitted are partitioned exactly into those already applied and those still waiting in the queue, with nothing double-applied and nothing silently dropped.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of admitted tasks always equals the disjoint union of the applied tasks and the tasks still in the queue, so no admitted update is ever lost or applied twice.

  /\ cap = 1

A power-grid load shedder decides which feeders to shed under overload. Shed requests for feeders are placed on a bounded work queue that applies backpressure when full, and a request for a feeder is admitted only if that feeder has not already been shed and is not already waiting in the queue. Worker processes take a queued request and carry out the shed, moving the feeder from the waiting queue into the set of already-shed feeders. A worker can crash silently at any moment and stop taking requests; a crashed worker's in-flight request simply remains queued and is picked up later, so nothing is lost and, crucially, no feeder is ever shed twice. A crashed worker may recover. At all times the feeders still waiting in the queue and the feeders already shed form two disjoint sets.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of feeders waiting in the queue and the set of feeders already shed are always disjoint, so the same feeder is never allocated a shed command twice.

  /\ lastSched' = sc

A hospital operating-room scheduler protects a single operating room, a critical resource, with a compare-and-swap register that names the room's current occupant or is marked free. Two independent scheduler instances share this one register and pool of surgical teams. A team first registers as waiting. To enter the room, a scheduler performs a compare-and-swap that succeeds only when the register currently reads free, atomically writing the team's identity into the register and marking the team as the occupant; it also notes which scheduler instance won the swap. The occupying team later leaves, which resets the register to free. Because entry succeeds only on a free register and the register can name only one occupant, at most one team occupies the room at any time and the register reads free exactly when the room is empty.

VARIABLES phase, votes, ledger, owner

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Bookings -> {"idle","voting","committed","aborted"}]
  /\ votes \in [Bookings -> SUBSET Departments]
  /\ ledger \subseteq Bookings
  /\ owner \in [Bookings -> Coordinators \cup {"none"}]

Init ==
  /\ phase = [b \in Bookings |-> "idle"]
  /\ votes = [b \in Bookings |-> {}]
  /\ ledger = {}
  /\ owner = [b \in Bookings |-> "none"]

Begin(c, b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "voting"]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, ledger>>

Vote(b, d) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "voting"
  /\ d \notin votes[b]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = votes[b] \cup {d}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ledger, owner>>

Commit(b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "voting"
  /\ votes[b] = Departments
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "committed"]
  /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, owner>>

Abort(b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "voting"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "aborted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, ledger, owner>>

Idle ==
  /\ \A b \in Bookings : phase[b] \in {"committed","aborted"}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, ledger, owner>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Coordinators, b \in Bookings : Begin(c, b)
  \/ \E b \in Bookings, d \in Departments : Vote(b, d)
  \/ \E b \in Bookings : Commit(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bookings : Abort(b)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<phase, votes, ledger, owner>>

LedgerMatchesCommitted == ledger = { b \in Bookings : phase[b] = "committed" }

CONSTANTS Bookings = {bk1,bk2} Departments = {d1,d2} Coordinators = {co1,co2}

NEXT Next

nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler confirms each surgery booking into a shared booking ledger through a two-phase commit among the participating departments. Two independent scheduler coordinators share this ledger and pool of bookings; whichever coordinator opens a booking becomes its owner for that round. Opening a booking moves it into a voting phase; each department then votes yes. When all departments have voted, the coordinator commits the booking, which atomically records it in the shared ledger; if a booking is instead aborted from the voting phase, it is not recorded. Because the ledger is written in the same step that a booking becomes committed, the ledger always contains exactly those bookings whose two-phase commit reached the committed state, and neither coordinator's confirmation is ever lost from the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared booking ledger always contains exactly the bookings whose transaction is in the committed state, so no committed confirmation is lost and no uncommitted booking is recorded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m6p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Bags, Nodes, MaxVer, MaxClock, LeaseDur
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, version, committed

TypeOK ==
  /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxClock
  /\ holder \in [Bags -> Nodes \cup {"none"}]
  /\ expiry \in [Bags -> 0 .. MaxClock + LeaseDur]
  /\ version \in [Bags -> 0 .. MaxVer]
  /\ committed \subseteq [bag: Bags, seq: 1 .. MaxVer]

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ holder = [b \in Bags |-> "none"]
  /\ expiry = [b \in Bags |-> 0]
  /\ version = [b \in Bags |-> 0]
  /\ committed = {}

Acquire(n, b) ==
  /\ (holder[b] = "none" \/ clock >= expiry[b])
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = n]
  /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = clock + LeaseDur]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, version, committed>>

Update(n, b) ==
  /\ holder[b] = n
  /\ clock < expiry[b]
  /\ version[b] < MaxVer
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![b] = version[b] + 1]
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {[bag |-> b, seq |-> version[b] + 1]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Release(b) ==
  /\ holder[b] # "none"
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, version, committed>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, version, committed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, b \in Bags : Acquire(n, b)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, b \in Bags : Update(n, b)
  \/ \E b \in Bags : Release(b)
  \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<clock, holder, expiry, version, committed>>

NoLostVersion ==
  \A b \in Bags :
    { c.seq : c \in { x \in committed : x.bag = b } } = (1 .. version[b])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Bags = {g1,g2} Nodes = {n1,n2} MaxVer = 2 MaxClock = 3 LeaseDur = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostVersion
nl:
An airport baggage router maintains a per-bag routing record that is updated by router nodes under lease-based ownership. To update a bag's record, a node must hold an unexpired lease on that bag; leases are granted with an expiry deadline measured against a global clock, and only one node holds a bag's lease at a time. Because updates arrive over the network they can be reordered, but the lease discipline forces every applied update for a bag to be serialized under the current leaseholder, each update advancing the bag's version by one and recording a committed entry stamped with the new version number. A leaseholder can release its lease, and an expired lease can be re-acquired by another node. Since versions advance strictly one at a time under a single leaseholder, the committed version numbers recorded for each bag form a contiguous run from one up to the bag's current version, with no gaps and no lost updates.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every bag, the set of committed update version numbers is exactly the contiguous range from one to the bag's current version, so no update is ever lost or skipped.

EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

VARIABLES reg, pending, issueLog

  /\ issueLog \in Seq([copy: Copies, patron: Patrons])

  /\ pending' = pending \cup {[copy |-> c, patron |-> p]}

CASIssue(c, p) ==

  /\ reg[c] = "avail"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![c] = p]
  /\ issueLog' = Append(issueLog, [copy |-> c, patron |-> p])
  /\ pending' = pending \ {[copy |-> c, patron |-> p]}

DropRequest(c, p) ==
  /\ [copy |-> c, patron |-> p] \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {[copy |-> c, patron |-> p]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, issueLog>>

Idle ==
  /\ \A c \in Copies : reg[c] # "avail"
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, pending, issueLog>>

Next ==

  \/ \E c \in Copies, p \in Patrons : CASIssue(c, p)

NEXT Next

A library reservation system issues physical book copies, an irreversible action, guarded by a compare-and-swap register per copy that reads either available or the identity of the patron who holds it. A patron first submits a pending request for a copy; some patrons are slow and leave their request pending for a while, but a slow patron is not failed and its request stays valid. To issue a copy, the system performs a compare-and-swap that succeeds only when the copy's register still reads available, atomically writing the patron's identity and appending the issue to an audit log. Because the compare-and-swap requires the register to read available and issuing never resets a register back to available, each copy can be issued at most once, and the audit log therefore never lists the same copy twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no book copy appears more than once in the issuance audit log, so the irreversible issuing of any copy happens at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od10m5p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Blocks, Controllers, Capacity, Quorum
VARIABLES occ, pending, votes, online

TypeOK ==
  /\ occ \in [Blocks -> 0 .. Capacity]
  /\ pending \in [Blocks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ votes \in [Blocks -> SUBSET Controllers]
  /\ online \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
  /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
  /\ pending = [b \in Blocks |-> FALSE]
  /\ votes = [b \in Blocks |-> {}]
  /\ online = Controllers

Propose(b) ==
  /\ pending[b] = FALSE
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, online>>

Vote(b, c) ==
  /\ pending[b] = TRUE
  /\ c \in online
  /\ c \notin votes[b]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = votes[b] \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, pending, online>>

Admit(b) ==
  /\ pending[b] = TRUE
  /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Quorum
  /\ occ[b] < Capacity
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = occ[b] + 1]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, online>>

Depart(b) ==
  /\ occ[b] > 0
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = occ[b] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes, online>>

Toggle(c) ==
  /\ online' = IF c \in online THEN online \ {c} ELSE online \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, pending, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Propose(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks, c \in Controllers : Vote(b, c)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Admit(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Depart(b)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Toggle(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<occ, pending, votes, online>>

CapacityNeverExceeded == \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] <= Capacity
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Blocks = {bl1,bl2} Controllers = {k1,k2,k3} Capacity = 2 Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityNeverExceeded

A subway signalling system controls a set of track blocks, each of which may hold no more than a fixed capacity of trains. Admitting a train into a block requires quorum voting: a proposed admission for a block must collect approval votes from a quorum of the signalling controllers before it takes effect. Controllers can be brought online or taken offline, and votes may arrive reordered, but only online controllers vote and an admission commits only once its vote tally reaches the quorum and the target block still has spare capacity. When an admission commits, the block's occupancy increases by one; when a train departs a block, its occupancy decreases by one. Because every admission checks that occupancy is below capacity before committing, no block's occupancy ever exceeds its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every block's occupancy is always less than or equal to its fixed capacity, so the bounded capacity of a block is never exceeded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m2p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Shafts, MaxRound
VARIABLES coord, rm, dispatched, round

TypeOK ==
  /\ coord \in {"init","committed","aborted"}
  /\ rm \in [Shafts -> {"working","prepared","committed","aborted","crashed"}]
  /\ dispatched \in 0 .. MaxRound
  /\ round \in 0 .. MaxRound

Init ==
  /\ coord = "init"
  /\ rm = [s \in Shafts |-> "working"]
  /\ dispatched = 0
  /\ round = 0

Prepare(s) ==
  /\ coord = "init"
  /\ rm[s] = "working"
  /\ rm' = [rm EXCEPT ![s] = "prepared"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, dispatched, round>>

Crash(s) ==
  /\ rm[s] = "working"
  /\ rm' = [rm EXCEPT ![s] = "crashed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, dispatched, round>>

CoordCommit ==
  /\ coord = "init"
  /\ \A s \in Shafts : rm[s] = "prepared"
  /\ coord' = "committed"
  /\ dispatched' = dispatched + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rm, round>>

CoordAbort ==
  /\ coord = "init"
  /\ \E s \in Shafts : rm[s] = "crashed"
  /\ coord' = "aborted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rm, dispatched, round>>

RMCommit(s) ==
  /\ coord = "committed"
  /\ rm[s] = "prepared"
  /\ rm' = [rm EXCEPT ![s] = "committed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, dispatched, round>>

RMAbort(s) ==
  /\ coord = "aborted"
  /\ rm[s] \in {"prepared","working"}
  /\ rm' = [rm EXCEPT ![s] = "aborted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, dispatched, round>>

ResetRound ==
  /\ coord \in {"committed","aborted"}
  /\ \A s \in Shafts : rm[s] \in {"committed","aborted","crashed"}
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ coord' = "init"
  /\ rm' = [s \in Shafts |-> "working"]
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED dispatched

Idle ==
  /\ coord \in {"committed","aborted"}
  /\ round = MaxRound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, rm, dispatched, round>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Shafts : Prepare(s)
  \/ \E s \in Shafts : Crash(s)
  \/ CoordCommit
  \/ CoordAbort
  \/ \E s \in Shafts : RMCommit(s)
  \/ \E s \in Shafts : RMAbort(s)
  \/ ResetRound
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<coord, rm, dispatched, round>>

NoUnilateralCommit == \A s \in Shafts : (rm[s] = "committed") => (coord = "committed")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Shafts = {sh1,sh2} MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoUnilateralCommit
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper commits each dispatch decision through a classic two-phase commit across per-shaft controllers, so that a dispatch is either applied by every shaft or by none. A coordinator drives the protocol: each shaft controller prepares (votes to commit) or crashes silently while still working. The coordinator decides commit only when all shafts have prepared, and decides abort if any shaft has crashed. A shaft controller moves to committed only after seeing the coordinator's commit decision, and to aborted only after seeing an abort decision. Thus a shaft never unilaterally commits a dispatch that the coordinator did not commit, and a silent crash forces a global abort rather than a partial, lost, or inconsistent update. After a decision resolves, the bank may reset for the next dispatch round, up to a bounded number of rounds.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever any shaft controller is in the committed state, the coordinator has also decided commit, so no shaft ever commits a dispatch that was not globally committed.

  /\ leases \subseteq [bay: Bays, car: Cars, ctrl: Controllers, exp: 1 .. MaxClock + LeaseDur]

  /\ UNCHANGED clock

  /\ \E g \in leases : g.bay = b
  /\ leases' = { g \in leases : g.bay # b }
  /\ UNCHANGED clock

  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED leases

NEXT Next

A car-wash conveyor line has several wash bays, each a critical resource that may hold only one car at a time. Two independent controllers share the pool of bays and coordinate access through time-limited leases: to admit a car to a bay, a controller issues a lease stamped with an expiry deadline measured against a global clock. A controller may issue a lease for a bay only when that bay has no currently valid (unexpired) lease; issuing atomically drops any expired lease already on that bay. A lease can be released early, and it becomes invalid on its own once the clock passes its expiry. Because a new lease is granted only when no valid lease exists for the bay, every bay carries at most one valid lease at any moment, so two cars are never admitted to the same bay even though two controllers share the pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every wash bay, the set of currently valid (unexpired) leases is empty or a single lease, so no bay is ever occupied by two cars at once.

---- MODULE W4Od14m1p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS TotalUnits
VARIABLES holder, load

Drones == 0 .. 2
Nxt(d) == (d + 1) % 3

TotalLoad ==
  LET f[S \in SUBSET Drones] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN load[x] + f[S \ {x}]
  IN f[Drones]

  /\ load \in [Drones -> 0 .. TotalUnits]

  /\ load = [d \in Drones |-> IF d = 0 THEN 2 ELSE IF d = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0]

Transfer(k) ==
  /\ k >= 1
  /\ load[holder] >= k
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![holder] = load[holder] - k,
                          ![Nxt(holder)] = load[Nxt(holder)] + k]
  /\ UNCHANGED holder

PassToken ==
  /\ holder' = Nxt(holder)
  /\ UNCHANGED load

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in 1 .. TotalUnits : Transfer(k)
  \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<holder, load>>

PacketsConserved == TotalLoad = TotalUnits
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS TotalUnits = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PacketsConserved
nl:
A wildfire surveillance drone swarm is arranged in a logical ring and collectively holds a fixed number of relay data-packets that must be neither created nor destroyed, only handed around. Each drone holds some number of packets. A single circulating token grants the exclusive right to move packets: only the drone currently holding the token may transfer some of its packets to its ring neighbour, decreasing its own count and increasing the neighbour's by the same amount. The token is passed hand-to-hand around the ring. A drone may be slow (it simply holds the token or does not transfer for a while) but it is not failed, so packets are never dropped. Because every transfer moves packets from one drone to the next without changing the grand total, and no action ever adds or removes packets, the sum of packets held across the whole swarm is invariant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of relay packets summed over all drones always equals the fixed initial total, so no packet is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m4p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences
CONSTANTS Tasks, MaxCap
VARIABLES queue, cap, lastServed, mode

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq(Tasks)
  /\ cap \in 1 .. MaxCap
  /\ lastServed \in Tasks \cup {"none"}
  /\ mode \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ cap = 1
  /\ lastServed = "none"
  /\ mode = FALSE

Enqueue(t) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, lastServed, mode>>

Serve ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ lastServed' = Head(queue)
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, mode>>

Expand ==
  /\ cap < MaxCap
  /\ cap' = cap + 1
  /\ mode' = ~mode
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lastServed>>

Shrink ==
  /\ cap > 1
  /\ cap - 1 >= Len(queue)
  /\ cap' = cap - 1
  /\ mode' = ~mode
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lastServed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Tasks : Enqueue(t)
  \/ Serve
  \/ Expand
  \/ Shrink

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<queue, cap, lastServed, mode>>

QueueWithinCapacity == Len(queue) <= cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Tasks = {j1,j2} MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QueueWithinCapacity
nl:
A container-ship crane yard buffers incoming lift tasks in a bounded work queue that feeds the cranes. The queue has a capacity that bounds how many tasks may wait at once; new tasks are admitted only while the number waiting is below the capacity, which is how the yard applies backpressure to upstream deliveries. A crane serves the task at the front of the queue, removing it. The yard supervisor can change the buffer capacity at runtime: the capacity may be expanded freely, or shrunk, but it may never be shrunk below the number of tasks currently waiting, so a shrink can only reclaim slack. Because admission requires strictly fewer waiting tasks than the capacity and shrinking is floored at the current occupancy, the number of tasks waiting in the queue never exceeds the current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of tasks waiting in the queue is always less than or equal to the current buffer capacity, so the bounded buffer capacity is never exceeded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m7p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Holds, Inventory, MaxVer
VARIABLES cnt, ver

StartHold == CHOOSE h \in Holds : TRUE

TotalCnt ==
  LET f[S \in SUBSET Holds] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN cnt[x] + f[S \ {x}]
  IN f[Holds]

TypeOK ==
  /\ cnt \in [Holds -> 0 .. Inventory]
  /\ ver \in [Holds -> 0 .. MaxVer]

Init ==
  /\ cnt = [h \in Holds |-> IF h = StartHold THEN Inventory ELSE 0]
  /\ ver = [h \in Holds |-> 0]

CASMove(src, dst) ==
  /\ src # dst
  /\ cnt[src] > 0
  /\ ver[src] < MaxVer
  /\ ver[dst] < MaxVer
  /\ cnt' = [cnt EXCEPT ![src] = cnt[src] - 1, ![dst] = cnt[dst] + 1]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![src] = ver[src] + 1, ![dst] = ver[dst] + 1]

AdminMove(src, dst) ==
  /\ src # dst
  /\ cnt[src] > 0
  /\ cnt' = [cnt EXCEPT ![src] = cnt[src] - 1, ![dst] = cnt[dst] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED ver

Idle ==
  /\ \A h \in Holds : ver[h] = MaxVer
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cnt, ver>>

Next ==
  \/ \E src, dst \in Holds : CASMove(src, dst)
  \/ \E src, dst \in Holds : AdminMove(src, dst)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<cnt, ver>>

InventoryConserved == TotalCnt = Inventory
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Holds = {h1,h2,h3} Inventory = 2 MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT InventoryConserved
nl:
A container-ship crane yard shuffles a fixed inventory of containers among several holds, and no container may be created or destroyed in the process. Each hold has a count of containers and a compare-and-swap version register used to serialize moves. A normal move transfers one container from a non-empty source hold to a destination hold: it reads the source register's version, and succeeds only if the version still matches, atomically decrementing the source count, incrementing the destination count, and bumping both registers' versions. A privileged yard admin may override the compare-and-swap and force a one-container move directly, but the override still moves exactly one container from source to destination. Because every move, normal or overridden, removes one container from one hold and adds one to another, the total number of containers across all holds is conserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of containers summed over all holds always equals the fixed initial inventory, so no container is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m7p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Workers, JobIds, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, owner, heldEpochs, spool

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
  /\ owner \in Workers \cup {"free"}
  /\ heldEpochs \in [Workers -> SUBSET (0 .. MaxEpoch)]
  /\ spool \subseteq [worker: Workers, epoch: 0 .. MaxEpoch, job: JobIds]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ owner = "free"
  /\ heldEpochs = [w \in Workers |-> {}]
  /\ spool = {}

AcquireCAS(w) ==
  /\ owner = "free"
  /\ owner' = w
  /\ heldEpochs' = [heldEpochs EXCEPT ![w] = heldEpochs[w] \cup {epoch}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, spool>>

Write(w, j) ==
  /\ owner = w
  /\ spool' = spool \cup {[worker |-> w, epoch |-> epoch, job |-> j]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, heldEpochs>>

Preempt ==
  /\ owner # "free"
  /\ owner' = "free"
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<heldEpochs, spool>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCAS(w)
  \/ \E w \in Workers, j \in JobIds : Write(w, j)
  \/ Preempt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<epoch, owner, heldEpochs, spool>>

AuthorizedWrites == \A r \in spool : r.epoch \in heldEpochs[r.worker]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Workers = {w1,w2} JobIds = {j1,j2} MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedWrites
nl:
A print shop spooler lets several worker processes append jobs to a shared spool, but write access is guarded by a compare-and-swap ownership token with a generation epoch. A worker acquires the token only when it currently reads free (a successful compare-and-swap from free to that worker), and acquiring records that the worker held the token during the current epoch. Only the worker that currently owns the token may append a job to the spool, and each appended job is stamped with the epoch in which it was written. Because messages can be reordered, appends and acquisitions from different workers interleave arbitrarily. A preemption frees the token and advances the epoch, so a worker that has been preempted becomes stale and can no longer append. Every job in the spool was therefore written by a worker during an epoch in which that worker genuinely held the token.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every job recorded in the spool is stamped with an epoch during which its writing worker actually held the ownership token, so no unauthorized or stale worker ever appears as a spool writer.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m6p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Planners, MaxClock, LeaseDur
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, changes

TypeOK ==
  /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxClock
  /\ holder \in Planners \cup {"none"}
  /\ expiry \in 0 .. MaxClock + LeaseDur
  /\ changes \subseteq [actor: Planners, madeAt: 0 .. MaxClock, leaseExp: 0 .. MaxClock + LeaseDur, admin: BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ holder = "none"
  /\ expiry = 0
  /\ changes = {}

Acquire(p) ==
  /\ holder = "none" \/ clock >= expiry
  /\ holder' = p
  /\ expiry' = clock + LeaseDur
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, changes>>

Commit(p) ==
  /\ holder = p
  /\ clock < expiry
  /\ Cardinality(changes) < 3
  /\ changes' = changes \cup {[actor |-> p, madeAt |-> clock, leaseExp |-> expiry, admin |-> FALSE]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

AdminOverride(p) ==
  /\ Cardinality(changes) < 3
  /\ changes' = changes \cup {[actor |-> p, madeAt |-> clock, leaseExp |-> expiry, admin |-> TRUE]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Release ==
  /\ holder # "none"
  /\ holder' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, changes>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, changes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Planners : Acquire(p)
  \/ \E p \in Planners : Commit(p)
  \/ \E p \in Planners : AdminOverride(p)
  \/ Release
  \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<clock, holder, expiry, changes>>

AuthorizedChanges == \A c \in changes : c.admin \/ (c.madeAt < c.leaseExp)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Planners = {p1,p2} MaxClock = 2 LeaseDur = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedChanges
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler lets planners commit schedule changes, but a planner may do so only while holding a valid time-limited lease on the schedule. A lease is acquired against a global clock and carries an expiry deadline; a planner may commit a change only while it holds the lease and the clock has not yet reached the lease's expiry. Every recorded change stores the clock time at which it was made and the expiry of the lease under which it was made. A planner whose lease has expired is stale and unauthorized: its attempts to commit are refused. Separately, a privileged administrator may override the lease discipline and force a change at any time, and such changes are marked as administrative. The clock advances monotonically. Consequently every recorded change is either an administrative override or was made strictly before its lease's expiry by a genuine leaseholder.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every recorded schedule change is either an administrative override or was made at a clock time strictly before the expiry of the lease under which it was committed, so no stale or unauthorized planner ever commits a change.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m2p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Stations, MaxTerm
VARIABLES term, active, reqTerm, votes, committed

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm
  /\ active \in BOOLEAN
  /\ reqTerm \in 0 .. MaxTerm
  /\ votes \subseteq Stations
  /\ committed \subseteq [opened: 0 .. MaxTerm, atCommit: 0 .. MaxTerm, admin: BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ active = FALSE
  /\ reqTerm = 0
  /\ votes = {}
  /\ committed = {}

Begin ==
  /\ active = FALSE
  /\ active' = TRUE
  /\ reqTerm' = term
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, committed>>

Vote(s) ==
  /\ active = TRUE
  /\ reqTerm = term
  /\ s \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, active, reqTerm, committed>>

Commit ==
  /\ active = TRUE
  /\ votes = Stations
  /\ reqTerm = term
  /\ Cardinality(committed) < 3
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {[opened |-> reqTerm, atCommit |-> term, admin |-> FALSE]}
  /\ active' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqTerm, votes>>

NewTerm ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ active' = FALSE
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqTerm, committed>>

AdminForce ==
  /\ Cardinality(committed) < 3
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {[opened |-> reqTerm, atCommit |-> term, admin |-> TRUE]}
  /\ active' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reqTerm, votes>>

Idle ==
  /\ Cardinality(committed) >= 3
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, active, reqTerm, votes, committed>>

Next ==
  \/ Begin
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Vote(s)
  \/ Commit
  \/ NewTerm
  \/ AdminForce
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<term, active, reqTerm, votes, committed>>

NoStaleCommit == \A c \in committed : c.admin \/ (c.opened = c.atCommit)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Stations = {st1,st2} MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleCommit
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line commits each wash-cycle change through a two-phase commit driven by a coordinator that is only authorized during the current configuration term. When a transaction is opened it is stamped with the coordinator's term; participating stations then vote, but a station votes only while the transaction's term still matches the live term. The coordinator commits only when all stations have voted and the transaction's term is still current, and each committed record stores both the term the transaction was opened under and the live term at the moment of commit. Advancing to a new configuration term abandons any in-flight transaction, so a coordinator left over from an earlier term is stale and can never drive a commit. A privileged administrator may override the protocol and force a commit, and such records are flagged as administrative. Thus every committed record is either an administrative override or has a matching opened-term and commit-term, proving it was driven by the currently authorized coordinator.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every committed record is either an administrative override or has its opened term equal to the live term at commit, so no stale or unauthorized coordinator ever drives a commit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m4p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Members, MaxTok, MaxCap
VARIABLES queue, issued, granted

RemoveAt(s, i) == SubSeq(s, 1, i - 1) \o SubSeq(s, i + 1, Len(s))

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq([member: Members, tok: 0 .. MaxTok])
  /\ issued \in [Members -> 0 .. MaxTok]
  /\ granted \subseteq [member: Members, presented: 0 .. MaxTok, current: 0 .. MaxTok]

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ issued = [m \in Members |-> 0]
  /\ granted = {}

Submit(m) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < MaxCap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, [member |-> m, tok |-> issued[m]])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, granted>>

Revoke(m) ==
  /\ issued[m] < MaxTok
  /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![m] = issued[m] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, granted>>

GrantAt(i) ==
  /\ i \in DOMAIN queue
  /\ queue[i].tok = issued[queue[i].member]
  /\ Cardinality(granted) < 3
  /\ granted' = granted \cup {[member |-> queue[i].member,
                               presented |-> queue[i].tok,
                               current |-> issued[queue[i].member]]}
  /\ queue' = RemoveAt(queue, i)
  /\ UNCHANGED issued

DropStale(i) ==
  /\ i \in DOMAIN queue
  /\ queue[i].tok # issued[queue[i].member]
  /\ queue' = RemoveAt(queue, i)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, granted>>

Idle ==
  /\ Cardinality(granted) >= 3
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, issued, granted>>

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Members : Submit(m)
  \/ \E m \in Members : Revoke(m)
  \/ \E i \in 1 .. MaxCap : GrantAt(i)
  \/ \E i \in 1 .. MaxCap : DropStale(i)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<queue, issued, granted>>

AuthorizedGrants == \A g \in granted : g.presented = g.current
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Members = {m1,m2} MaxTok = 2 MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedGrants
nl:
A library reservation service buffers incoming reservation requests in a bounded intake queue that applies backpressure once full. Each request presents the member's credential token, which the member obtained from the service; the service keeps the currently issued token number for each member. Because requests are processed out of order, the granting engine may pick any request in the queue, not just the front one. A request is granted only if the token it presents equals the member's currently issued token, and each granted reservation records both the token that was presented and the token that was current for that member at the moment of the grant. A member's token can be revoked and reissued, incrementing the issued number and making any earlier token stale; a request presenting a stale token is dropped rather than granted. Therefore every granted reservation has a presented token equal to the member's issued token at grant time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every granted reservation, the presented credential token equals the token that was currently issued to that member at the moment of grant, so no stale or unauthorized request is ever granted.
